items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: And that's Charlie, my brother there. That's the old Absinthe House... We stayed there for three years in that job.

ctx.x: Henry Martin. Mm-hmm. And that's Charlie, my brother there. That's the old Absinthe House. See that rail you've been in there, eh? Mm-hmm. That old rail and everything. We stayed there for three years in that job. They were dancing there then, you know?
Mm-hmm. Who replaced you in the old Absinthe House?
